issues.condition_14_3: a live field contains future or post-race information
issues.title: LiveVM.forecast carries the race-derived reference (obs, err_cs, n_race) into the Live Predictor view model
issues.reproduction: cd proto && ../.venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from app_v2.services import lock_repository as LR, replay_service as RS, view_models as VM; lock=LR.load_lock(); c=RS.ReplayCursor('Monza','LIN',53).seek(30); vm=VM.build_live(lock,'Monza','LIN',c); print(vm.forecast.observed, vm.forecast.err, vm.forecast.n_race)"  -> 0.023 0.0072 214 (post-race values in the live path; same for live.viewmodel.build_live_vm)
issues.note: Not rendered on the Live Predictor, decision board or feedback pages today (only forecast.source is shown), so no screen shows post-race data; the violation is the data boundary in code (Phase 0 acceptance test 4: 'Live cannot read post-race reference fields'). Fix is a scrub: the live path must receive a forecast-only projection (prediction, band90, issued, gate, basis, n_prac, source) with observed/observed_se/err/n_race set to None, e.g. a LockView.forecast_for(..., live=True) or dataclasses.replace(f, observed=None, observed_se=None, err=None, n_race=None) in build_live (both app_v2/services/view_models.py and live/viewmodel.py).
issues.recommended_decision: GO_WITH_REASSIGNMENT: two-line fix in each view model plus a test asserting LiveVM.forecast.observed is None; no rollback needed
